_comment: Classical trot with CONVEX-MPC stance (stance_mode 1), SLOW variant (2026-10-28): half the
previous cadence (1.20 Hz + 0.43/(m/s), was 2.40 + 0.85), 12 cm swing (was 7.7), forward reach 22 cm,
duty 0.76. Loaded by go2_rl_policy_node as a registry entry of kind 'classical'; params override
classical_gait.GaitParams; MPC is classical_gait.ConvexMPC (parity-tested twin of the sim controller).
kp/kd are the gains it was tuned under; params.ff_kp must equal kp. Tuned and evaluated for FORWARD
walking up to 0.3 m/s only, so command_ranges allow forward 0..0.3 and nothing else (turning failed
even on the nominal robot at this cadence). First test: --dry-run, then hoisted, then ground.

sim_eval.forward_0.3_randomised: 5 falls / 64 robots / 30 s, 0.31 m/s, tilt 1.1 deg
sim_eval.randomised: mass -1..+3 kg, CoM +0..5 cm, friction 0.2-1.6, gains +-20%, latency 0-20 ms, rough tiles; no pushes

previous.note: the 2.4 Hz / 7.7 cm gait exported 2026-10-23 with commands x -0.3..0.8, y +-0.3, yaw +-1
